title: Cyberpunk 2077
notes: REDengine 4 RDAR archives (the redengine plugin); Kraken (Oodle) segments are inflated through the game's own bin/x64/oo2ext_*_win64.dll (never shipped by ViWo). The cyberpunk2077 game plugin names members from the community path list (cp77-hashes) and decompiles r6/cache/final.redscripts (redscript); WolvenKit decodes CR2W resources (textures to PNG, meshes to glTF, every resource to JSON) and packs edits into an override archive. 86 GB.
source: own testing (308 members out of basegame_2_mainmenu.archive; sqc/ctf.json pass-cyberpunk-2077)
